---
title: "Timetable"
---

The course runs over three and a half days, from Monday 7 to Thursday 10
September 2026, at the London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine.

Each day pairs short introductory lectures with longer computer practicals.
Slides for each session are linked from the session pages.

## Daily pattern

| | |
|---|---|
| 09:30 – 12:30 | Morning block, with a half-hour coffee break |
| 12:30 – 13:30 | Lunch |
| 13:30 – 17:00 | Afternoon block, with a half-hour coffee break |

Registration opens at 09:00 on the Monday. Thursday is a half day, finishing
after the morning block. Tea and coffee are provided during the breaks.

## Further material

Two sessions are provided for self-study rather than taught in the room:

- [Variational inference](sessions/variational_inference.qmd)
- [Universal differential equations](sessions/universal_differential_equations.qmd)

Both build on the taught sessions and can be worked through afterwards at your
own pace.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## A note on timings

Session start times are indicative. Each session page carries its own estimated
duration, and in practice sessions run to the pace of the room rather than the
clock. The Wednesday afternoon deliberately holds an open slot so that anything
which has overrun earlier in the week has somewhere to go.
:::
